description: Watch a video (local path or URL): `want` picks the view — grids of timestamped frames (default), the spoken transcript, or probe metadata alone. `from`/`until` window any of them. Local files render on the spot; a URL answers with download options to confirm first.

from.description: Window start: seconds (83) or timestamp ("1:23", "1:02:03"). Omit to start from the beginning.

look.description: How to look: overview (fast triage), detailed (miss nothing), read_text (few large frames to read on-screen text/UI), track_motion (dense small frames for fast action). Subtitle text always rides along in metadata regardless; this only affects frame size/density. Omit for a balanced default.

raw.description: Expert escape hatch: verbatim agent-video core CLI arguments starting with the subcommand, e.g. "process --strategy keyframes --base-fps 0.2". Mutually exclusive with every other argument. Input/output plumbing is injected by the server.

source.description: Local video file path or URL. Call with only `source` first; the response tells you what to do next.

strategy.description: Which moments become frames: adaptive (default: keyframes plus fill in sparse stretches, right for most footage), keyframes (cheapest scan, frames land on cuts — triage for edited footage, blind to changes inside static shots), uniform (evenly spaced in time — use when keyframes mislead: screen recordings, slides, long static takes). Orthogonal to look, which sets frame size/density.

until.description: Window end, same formats. Omit to go to the end of the video.

want.description: Which view to return over the window: grids (default — frame grids you read directly), transcript (the spoken text as "MM:SS text" lines; whisper runs once and the result then rides along with every grid), plan (probe metadata and follow-up calls, decoding nothing). For a long video, transcript first is the cheapest way to find what is worth looking at.

tools.description: Authorize one pending action a `video` response asked for. Pass the source it concerned and one token copied from that response's `tokens`.

source.description: The exact source the pending action concerned.

token.description: One token copied verbatim from a `confirm_required` response. Tokens stay valid until a newer plan for the same source replaces them.
